hints.title: Separate the sign
hints.body: Work with the absolute value, then restore the sign at the end.

hints.title: Build one digit at a time
hints.body: Take the last digit with modulo ten and append it to the reversed number.

hints.title: Guard the range
hints.body: Check the signed 32-bit limits before returning; the negative limit has one more allowed unit than the positive limit.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
sign = -1 if value < 0 else 1
number = absolute value of value
reversed = 0
while number > 0:
    reversed = reversed * 10 + number % 10
    number = number // 10
if sign == 1 and reversed > 2147483647: return 0
if sign == -1 and reversed > 2147483648: return 0
return sign * reversed
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
